name: Disable Large Send Offload
description: Disables Large Send Offload on physical network adapters to reduce latency spikes caused by packet batching.

description_i18n.en: Disables Large Send Offload on physical network adapters to reduce latency spikes caused by packet batching.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Large Send Offload auf physischen Netzwerkadaptern, um Latenzspitzen durch Paket-Batching zu reduzieren.
description_i18n.fr: Désactivé Large Send Offload sur les cartes réseau physiques afin de réduire les pics de latence lies au regroupement des paquets.

warnings.title: Adapter support varies
warnings.message: Only physical network adapters that expose Large Send Offload advanced properties will be affected by this tweak

compatibility.notes: Only applies to adapters that expose Large Send Offload advanced properties.

technical_details: Updates supported NetAdapter advanced properties whose display name contains Large Send Offload, LSO V2, or IPv4/IPv6 keywords
